coldDefinition: Fresh process and copied, closed SQLite database per sample; OS page cache is not flushed.
scope: Product SQLite and paged Session read, real DSH AgentLoop/SystemPrompt/TokenMeter/tools; synthetic model transport without request cloning. Image references traverse history; image decoding/upload and MyAgents UI require separate campaigns. Child cases measure native parent-child Session history, not full ProductWork orchestration.
noiseRule: Before candidate implementation, freeze each workload/metric ceiling at baseline p95 + max(3 * (p95 - median), metric floor). Duration floor 10 ms; peak RSS floor 16384 KiB. Evaluate candidate median and p95 against the frozen ceiling; never relax after observing candidate results.
